items.title: Prediction markets tied to clinical trials and drug approvals draw lawmakers' ire
items.summary: Prediction market event contracts on both clinical drug trials and Food and Drug Administration regulatory approvals are drawing attention from two Democratic senators, according to a letter obtained first by CNBC.

items.title: Fed's Goolsbee calls inflation report 'borderline disturbing' as central bank weighs more hikes
items.summary: Chicago Federal Reserve President Austan Goolsbee called the latest inflation data "borderline disturbing."

items.title: Alibaba announces plans to list T-Head, its Nvidia chip rival
items.summary: Chinese tech and e-commerce giant Alibaba announced late Tuesday that the Hong Kong Stock Exchange will allow the company to spin off its semiconductor subsidiary T-Head.

items.title: Analysis: Is Nvidia too big to fail? Its AI financing web raises the stakes
items.summary: The swirl of sex-and-spying allegations around Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang is raising a worrying question: Could trouble at the chipmaker spread through the tightly connected financial network Nvidia has built to support the artificial intelligence boom?

items.title: Consumers are showing signs of strain even as they keep spending, CNBC/NRF Retail Monitor shows
items.summary: Retail sales rose at their slowest pace in nearly a year in October as American consumers showed signs of strain from high prices, according to the latest CNBC/NRF Retail Monitor.
